title: What If Every Old Phone and Laptop Got Recycled?

scenes.text: What if every dead phone and laptop got recycled? Right now, fewer than one in four does.
In 2022 the world threw away 62 million tonnes of electronics. Parked as trucks, they would circle the equator.
Only 22.3 percent was formally collected and recycled. The other 77 percent was not.
Those devices held metals worth about 91 billion dollars, including roughly 15 billion in gold and 19 billion in copper.
About 62 billion dollars of recoverable resources went unaccounted for in 2022 alone.
Today, e-waste recycling meets just 1 percent of rare earth demand. And the pile is heading for 82 million tonnes by 2030.
